verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the homepage claim that Rainforest offers pre-built embeddable components for chargebacks. That suggests some dispute-handling surface exists for its marketplace and platform merchants, but nothing details how disputes are managed per seller. Missing for 10: documentation that chargebacks are attributed to the correct sub-merchant, an evidence-submission API or dashboard flow, automatic posting of dispute outcomes to seller balances or deposits, dispute webhook events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
